about.title: Built from the basics up.
about.lede: From a two-person design studio to leading engineering at an insurer. Every step added a new piece.
about.storyHeading: I started by *developing pixels* for clients. Today I lead the tech that ship them at enterprise scale.
about.story:
My first venture, PicAffectz, was a web and graphic design studio I ran while pursuing graduation. Since then I've built myself at several organizations including Deloitte, Optum (UnitedHealth Group) and now Bandhan Life, formerly Aegon Life.

I care about clean architecture, typed code and interfaces that make complex numbers easy to read.
about.quote: “You have it *on paper*, trust me, I'll make it *real*.”
